0.description: Fixed an issue where Fel Reaver Warning Sound debuff would take you out of stealth. (Active on next server restart.)

5.description: The Heroic Key Containers that go into your collection now indicate that they need to be opened again after purchasing the key.

1.description: Improved Spirit Tap will now grant the correct haste rating.
Fixed an issue where Fingers of Frost sometimes would be consumed when proccing.

6.description: Fixed an issue that had occured within the past 48 hours to cause seasonal to have two Karazhan Auras causing the raid to be more difficult than intended.
Prince Malchezaar's Infernal will now have a more visible indicator for their landing position. This requires a new patch.
Chess Event: Corrected an issue where the Dust Covered Chest could spawn multiple times per week.
Chess Event: Greatly Improved targeting logic of abilities.
Chess Event: Physical damage abilities now ignore armor.
Terestian Illhoof's Demonic Chain will now be removed when combat ends.
The Crone's Cyclones will no longer knock up player and instead will now periodically pull player into their center. This should prevent player from getting stuck in knock up limbo.
Chain Lightning now has reversed chain logic. Instead of increasing in damage with each jump, the damage now reduces.
The Crone can now cast Chain Lightning while moving.
Corrected an issue where his guests could be pulled without Moroes himself.

5.description: FIxed an issue where some Bloodforged S1 pieces had incorrect Resilience and PvP Power values.

1.description: Fixed a bug where Deep Freeze damage effect would not be affected by Shatter critical strike chance when used with Fingers of Frost.
Fixed an issue where the proc rate of the Molten Core talent was higher than intended.
Fixed an issue where the first rank of Maul generated more threat than intended.
Fixed an issue where Devastate wasn't generating threat from its application of Sunder Armor.
Fixed an issue where the damage reduction effect of Titan's Grip sometimes wasn't applying properly.

7.description: Reduced the stacks of Apprentice of Shadows from the Master of Shadow LRE to 3 from 5. Increased the haste granted to 8/16/24% from 3/6/9/12/15% and agility conversion to 15/30/45% from 8/16/24/32/40%. (This change requires a restart.)
[Legacy] Re-enabled the Prophet of Wrath mystic enchant.
Doubled the scaling of Master of Shadows damage.
Fixed an issue where Master of Shadows could trigger the Relentless Strikes talent in an unintended way.
Fixed an issue where Sinister Flurry would not grant stacks of Apprentice of Shadow or proc the damage from Master of Shadows.

0.description: You can no longer send mail to deactivated or dereferenced characters.
Fixed a bug where pet combat would activate pvp combat timer.
Fixed a client crash that was caused by invalid morph IDs when using Incarnations.
Battleground scoreboards will now show players with their correct faction.

4.description: Spectator: Arena games will now only show on the spectator NPC when they are already in progress.
Crows Cache: The cache can no longer spawn in 1v1 honorable combat zones.
PvE Mode: Attacking world bosses in PvE mode will transfer you to PvP mode.
PvE Mode: Fixed a bug where PvE mode players could attack PvP mode players.

2.description: Bonus Zones: Fixed a bug where players could obtain 100% and 300% XP boost auras when leveling from 55 to 56 in a bonus zone.

1.description: Fixed an issue where the stacking buff from the Discipline talent Meditation would cap at 10 stacks.
Fixed an issue where Infected Wounds wasn't properly reducing periodic healing taken by the amount shown in the tooltip.

6.description: Prince Malchezaar's Shadow Nova ability once again has a 30 yard knockback radius in Flex.
Karazhan's Crystal Strike ability can now be blocked.
Karazhan's Gaping Maw ability can now be blocked.
Karazhan's Deadly Swathe ability can now be blocked.
Karazhan's Ravage ability can now be blocked.
Karazhan's Acidic Fang ability can now be blocked.
Karazhan's Shadow Cleave ability can now be blocked.
Karazhan's Knockdown ability can now be blocked.
Karazhan's Hoof Strike ability can now be blocked.
Karazhan's Heroic Strike ability can now be blocked.
Karazhan's Cleave ability can now be blocked.

The Curator can now continue his Termination (Line/Explosions) effect while Evocating. Pending Do Not Touch the Display (warnings) are still cancelled when Evocation starts. This change only prevents The Curator from randomly blowing up a chunk of the room once Evocation ends.
Corrected an issue where Nightbane's Smoking Blast ability would deal Physical damage instead of Fire damage.
Nightbane's Restless Skeleton's Immolation effect will now trigger every 2 seconds, up from 1.
Corrected an issue where Prince Malchezaar's Void Warden would fall to the ground instead of sitting in the air.
Prince Malchezaar's Void Warden is now placed in the center of his room.
Prince Malchezaar's Doom ability now destroys infernals in between him and his target.
Corrected an issue where Prince Malchezaar's Adumbral Pool effect could be placed in the air or under the ground.
Prince Malchezaar now has an Infernal spawn point next to his door.
Prince Malchezaar's Doom ability now has a 0.5 second pre-cast.
Netherspite's Ethereal Entities are no longer guaranteed to charge players before exploding on Flex mode.
Corrected an issue where Terestian Illhoof's Demon Chains would move to the side when spawning.
Netherspite's Ethereal Entites now have use a red Arcane Explosion effect.
The Curator can now continue his Termination effect while Evocating.
The Curator's Do NOT Touch the Displays effect will now be removed when he Evocates.
The Curator's Hateful Bolt ability now prefers to target the player with the second highest threat.
Corrected an issue where The Opera House's Audience could express disinterest in Shapeshifts.
The Curator's Astral Flares are no longer immune to Arcane damage.
Corrected an issue where The Opera House's Stench of Failure effect could be placed in the air or under the stage.
Corrected an issue where you could rarely kill Attumen before Midnight.
Corrected a logic hole in the improved targetting of Prince Malchezaar's Infernals.
Slightly reduced the radius of Prince Malchezaar's Doom's (Line of Fire) damage effect to prevent players from getting hit while standing outside of the effect.
Prince Malchezaar's Enfeeble ability now has a target limit of 3-10 (10-25 players), down from 5-10.
Prince Malchezaar's Amplify Damage ability can now stack 50 times.
Prince Malchezaar's Amplify Damage ability now lasts 60 seconds, up from 10.
Prince Malchezaar's Amplify Damage ability will now increase damage taken from 5%, down from 100%.
Prince Malchezaar's Cleave ability can no longer be Dodged, Parried, or Blocked.
Prince Malchezaar's Cleave ability is now used on his next swing.
Prince Malchezaar's Shadow Nova ability can now be casted while moving.
Prince Malchezaar's Shadow Nova ability will now knock back players in a 45 yard radius, up from 30.
Prince Malchezaar's Shadow Nova ability will now deal damage in a 15 yard radius, down from 30.
Prince Malchezaar's Shadow Nova ability will now ignore Line of Sight.
Prince Malchezaar's Shadow Nova ability is no longer affected by cast time modifiers.
Prince Malchezaar's Shadow Word: Pain ability can now only target players.
Prince Malchezaar's Shadow Word: Pain ability now has a range of 100 yards, up from 30.
Corrected an issue where Netherspite's Perseverance effect would restore the player's health to full each tick, making it impossible for Netherspite to kill his target.
Netherspite's Perseverance effect now reduces the target's size by 2% per stack.
Netherspite's Perseverance effect no longer increases the targets Defense Rating.
Corrected an issue where The Shade of Aran's Conjured Elementals' base health was lower than intended.
